BiblicalUsage: Harisah is a ruin, something demolished, and it appears once, in the promise that the ruin will be rebuilt. In Amos 9:11 God says he will raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof, and raise up his ruins.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the promise is aimed straight at the ruins: God does not clear them away and start elsewhere, he raises up the very thing that fell.
